_readme: Copy this file to settings.json in the same folder and edit it. settings.json is gitignored. Patterns are case-insensitive regular expressions.
_timezone: Your local time zone. It decides what counts as 'today' for the daily count and logs.
_daily_target: Confirmed applications per day you are aiming for (all agents combined).
_min_score: Lowest AI fit score (1-10) a job needs before it is queued.
_senior_min_score: Titles matching senior_title_pattern need at least this score.
_special_min_score: Optional: one title pattern allowed at a different score. Leave title_pattern empty to turn off.
_title_exclude: Never apply to titles matching any of these.
_title_exclude_levels: Seniority words to skip, e.g. roles below your level.
_preferred_title_pattern: Titles you want first when everything else is equal.
_salary_minimum: Skip jobs whose posted maximum pay is below this (yearly). 0 turns it off.
_excluded_companies: Companies you never want to apply to.
_excluded_industries: Patterns in the title or description that rule a job out.
_staffing_firms: Staffing agencies. They are exempt from the per-company cap because each role is a different client.
_company_cap: At most this many submitted applications per company within company_cap_days.
_us_only: true keeps only US and remote-US roles.
_need_sponsorship: true skips postings that say they cannot sponsor a work visa.
_region_priority: Location patterns in order of preference; earlier ones rank higher. Others come last.
_resumes: Paths are relative to the 'ApplyPilot setup' folder. The first variant whose title_pattern matches is sent; otherwise the default.
_scan_title_keep: Scan stage: only score titles matching this pattern. Empty scores every title.
_scan_title_drop: Scan stage: never score titles matching any of these.
_gmail_address: Your own address, so the email tracker can ignore messages you sent.
_launchd_label: Name of the macOS background job that runs the scan pipeline.
